decision.name: CLOSE_FALSE_GREEN_READER_ALTERNATIVE
decision.finding: The prior three-stage failpoint matrix asserts all-T0 persisted files, yet its prose allows a fail-closed versioned snapshot-reader alternative. That alternative is NOT tested by the matrix; public runner publishes three files individually and no versioned snapshot reader is identified. Passing the raw-file test cannot prove reader safety, and a future valid fail-closed reader would fail the all-T0 assertion. This is a test/acceptance-contract mismatch, not an executed product failure.
decision.resolution: Maintain two explicit non-interchangeable acceptance routes: WRITER_ATOMICITY requires three-stage no-network failpoint matrix with all T0 files retained; READER_FAIL_CLOSED requires a named production snapshot reader API, generation identity or manifest, and deterministic test showing it rejects/retries T1/T0/T0 and T1/T1/T0, including same-as_of generations. Until such API and executed tests exist, READER_FAIL_CLOSED is NOT_EVALUABLE and must not be cited as GREEN. Freeze further speculative A test expansion; prioritize exact-SHA executable evidence for existing P0/P0.5/P1 and writer matrix.

blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Use authorized isolated checkout pinned to exact public SHA with 17 Capital Flow test files, verify SHA/inventory, execute unchanged baseline, test-only existing non-skipped P0/P0.5/P1 and three-stage failpoint regressions, then full suite; retain stdout/stderr, exit codes, overlay hashes and overlap witnesses. Do not retry known DNS clone.
